# Browser libraries

Frozen local copies of the libraries already used by this portfolio, downloaded 2026-11-11. Original license headers are preserved. Lenis and Lucide license files accompany their distributions. GSAP and ScrollTrigger preserve their original copyright and license URL in the distribution headers.

- GSAP 3.12.5: https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/gsap/3.12.5/gsap.min.js
- ScrollTrigger 3.12.5: https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/gsap/3.12.5/ScrollTrigger.min.js
- Lenis 1.1.2: https://unpkg.com/lenis@1.1.2/dist/lenis.min.js
- Lucide 1.72.0: https://unpkg.com/lucide@1.72.0/dist/umd/lucide.js (version identified from the downloaded distribution header)

GSAP / ScrollTrigger retain the license terms of version 3.12.5; see the original headers and https://gsap.com/standard-license. Lenis uses MIT; Lucide uses ISC.
